Aipas Gentry A4 Folding Electric Bike Overview
The Aipas Gentry A4 Folding eBike blends power, portability, and performance in a compact, step-thru design that’s perfect for urban commutes, off-road exploration, or leisure rides. With its 1000W motor, advanced suspension, and lightweight frame, the A4 delivers an exceptional balance of comfort, style, and practicality for every rider.

Benefit: Handles diverse terrains—from city streets to countryside paths—with confidence and ease. Optimize your motor performance with the Brushless Motor Controller for smoother, more efficient power delivery.

2. Smooth and Comfortable Riding

Gears: Shimano 7-speed transmission for a versatile riding experience For added comfort, pair it with the Extra Large Seat or Suspension Seatpost.

3. Foldable and Step-Thru Design

Portability: Foldable design for simple transport and storage—ideal for car trips, RVs, or apartments

Safety: Integrated front headlight and rear taillight for safe night riding Add extra carrying capacity with the Front Basket or Hard Shell Rear Shelf Bag.

4. Long Range & Certified Safety

Certification: SGS Certification UL2849 for the highest battery safety standards For longer journeys, upgrade to the A4 48V 14Ah Battery for extended range and durability.

5. Impressive Speed

Top Speed: 28 mph for fast, efficient commuting and recreational rides Enjoy thrilling performance while maintaining complete control on every route.

6. Multiple Riding Modes

Modes: Cruise control, assist mode, sport mode, pedal assist mode, and pure electric mode

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed gearing system allows smooth, adaptive riding for all conditions.

7. Lighting and Safety Features

Extra Safety: Separate horn and light buttons for quick alerting Stay visible and secure on every journey—pair with the Lighted Cycling Helmet for added safety.

Rider Height Range: Perfect for riders between 4'10" and 6'3" Enjoy flexibility without compromising strength or balance.

9. Quick Charging

Charging Time: Fully recharges in just 4–6 hours, minimizing downtime and maximizing adventure.

User-Friendly: Quick and simple setup, even for first-time riders.

Summary
The Aipas Gentry A4 Folding Electric Bike offers a premium combination of power, comfort, and convenience in a stylish, foldable design. Its 1000W motor and 78Nm torque deliver confident performance across terrains, while the SGS Certification UL2271 48V 12.8Ah battery provides reliable range up to 62 miles. Lightweight yet durable, the A4 supports riders of all sizes and offers advanced lighting, safety, and control features.
Whether commuting, exploring, or relaxing, the Gentry A4 ensures an efficient, smooth, and stylish journey every time. Complete your setup with accessories like the Bike Lock and Cube Electric Air Pump to keep your ride secure and adventure-ready.
